questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: To explore the mode of inheritance further we performed a complex segregation ___.
questions.stemZh: 为进一步探究遗传方式，我们进行了复杂的分离分析。
questions.explanation: segregation analysis 是遗传学固定搭配，意为“分离分析”；inspection 检查、diagnosis 诊断、arrangement 安排都不能与 segregation 搭配表达此义。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The amount of carbon dioxide in the air is rapidly ___ the limits proposed by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.
questions.stemZh: 空气中的二氧化碳含量正迅速接近政府间气候变化专门委员会提出的上限。
questions.explanation: approach 作动词表示“接近（某一数值或界限）”；process 加工、accomplish 完成、account 解释/占（比例）均不符合语境。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: This mature Greensboro Country Park covers a/an ___ of 125 acres and is set in the countryside surrounding a reservoir.
questions.stemZh: 这座成熟的格林斯伯勒郊野公园占地125英亩，坐落在水库周围的乡村中。
questions.explanation: cover an area of... 是固定表达“占地……面积”；size 尺寸、space 空间、land 土地都不能与 cover a/an ... of 搭配表示面积。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The MTFS made a deliberately modest ___ of future rates of economic growth.
questions.stemZh: MTFS对未来经济增长率作了刻意保守的评估。
questions.explanation: make an assessment of... 表示“对……作出评估”；research 研究、judgment 判断、determination 决心/测定，都不如 assessment 贴合“对增长率作评估”。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: It is reasonable to ___ that the economy will continue to improve and the unemployment rate will decrease.
questions.stemZh: 有理由认为经济将继续改善，失业率将下降。
questions.explanation: It is reasonable to assume that... 是常用句式“有理由认为……”；pretend 假装、guarantee 保证、recognize 承认，语气都不符。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The federal government has the ___ to regulate phone service provided over the Internet.
questions.stemZh: 联邦政府有权监管通过互联网提供的电话服务。
questions.explanation: have the authority to do sth. 表示“有权做某事”；majority 多数、identity 身份、community 社区均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Little information is ___ on how much time was spent on labour activities once pupils had left school.
questions.stemZh: 关于学生离校后花多少时间从事劳动活动，现有信息很少。
questions.explanation: information is available on... 表示“关于……有可获取的信息”；visible 可见的、present 在场的、feasible 可行的均不搭配。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: According to the survey, health care coverage costs too much and the ___ aren't good enough.
questions.stemZh: 调查显示，医疗保险费用过高，而保障福利又不够好。
questions.explanation: 与 costs too much 对比，此处指医保的“福利/保障”不够好，benefits 最合；defects 缺陷、advantages 优势、efficiency 效率均不贴合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The topic of dynamics is based on the ___ that forces create movements which can be described as spatial changes within an all-controlling time domain.
questions.stemZh: 动力学这一主题建立在这样一个概念之上：力产生运动，而运动可描述为在完全受控的时间域内的空间变化。
questions.explanation: be based on the concept that... 表示“建立在……概念之上”；origin 起源、equation 方程、formula 公式都不能概括后面的命题。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Despite these limitations, our results are ___ with previous studies that included pain assessment by patients and physicians.
questions.stemZh: 尽管存在这些局限，我们的结果与以往包含医患疼痛评估的研究是一致的。
questions.explanation: be consistent with 表示“与……一致”，符合转折语境；be different from、be composed of、be contrary to 的搭配或语义不符。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: He wants a new government, possibly with ___ reform at the top of its agenda—including a blueprint for a stronger presidency.
questions.stemZh: 他想要一个新政府，可能把宪政改革列在议程首位——包括一份加强总统权力的蓝图。
questions.explanation: 与 government、presidency 呼应，constitutional reform 指“宪政改革”；commercial 商业的、conventional 传统的、institutional 制度的都不如 constitutional 具体。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: His proposals can only be understood in the current cultural ___ of our nation.
questions.stemZh: 他的提议只有放在我国当前的文化背景中才能被理解。
questions.explanation: in the ... context of 表示“在……背景下”，为固定搭配；occasion 场合、occurrence 发生、status 地位均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The services that his company must provide under the ___ have been made more specific to reflect the consumers' needs.
questions.stemZh: 他的公司依据合同必须提供的服务已变得更加具体，以反映消费者的需求。
questions.explanation: under the contract 表示“依据合同”，与 provide services 呼应；contact 联系、settlement 解决/结算、assurance 保证均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The technology is being used to ___ more flexibility for the employer rather than the employee.
questions.stemZh: 这项技术正被用来为雇主而非雇员带来更大的灵活性。
questions.explanation: create flexibility 表示“带来灵活性”；cause 引起（多指问题）、emerge 不及物“出现”、invent 发明具体物，均不搭配。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Scientists hope that ___ from the space probe will pave the way for a more detailed exploration of Mars.
questions.stemZh: 科学家希望太空探测器传回的数据将为更详细地探索火星铺平道路。
questions.explanation: space probe 传回的是 data（数据/资料），为不可数集合名词；media 媒体、messages 信息、figures 数字都不如 data 准确。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Blu-ray allows consumers to view movies and other programs in high ___ , offering more than five times the storage capacity of traditional DVDs.
questions.stemZh: 蓝光使消费者能以高清观看电影和其他节目，其存储容量是传统DVD的五倍以上。
questions.explanation: high definition 是固定术语“高清”；dimension 维度、precision 精确、description 描述均不与 high 搭配表示画质。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The criteria illustrated were ___ from an analysis of several topics selected from the Cockcroft Foundation list.
questions.stemZh: 所说明的标准源自对从科克罗夫特基金会清单中选出的若干主题的分析。
questions.explanation: be derived from 表示“源自/由……推导得出”；originate from 常用主动语态；direct 指导、produce 生产均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Several studies have looked at the geographical ___ of doctors both in regions and in smaller districts.
questions.stemZh: 若干研究考察了医生在地区和更小区域内的地理分布。
questions.explanation: geographical distribution 指“地理分布”；division 分工/划分、separation 分离、circulation 流通均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Government-led investment in infrastructure and technology aims to boost individual consumption and ___ competitiveness.
questions.stemZh: 政府主导的基础设施和技术投资旨在提振个人消费和经济竞争力。
questions.explanation: 与 investment、consumption 并列，economic competitiveness 指“经济竞争力”；religious 宗教的、academic 学术的、artistic 艺术的均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Technology facilitates aspects of our teaching ___ and practice that make these improvements possible.
questions.stemZh: 技术改善了我们的教学环境和实践，使这些改进成为可能。
questions.explanation: teaching environment 指“教学环境”，与 practice 并列；territory 领土、surroundings 周围环境、situation 形势都不如 environment 贴切。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: This set of principles and criteria are well ___ and almost uniformly accepted by experts in this field.
questions.stemZh: 这套原则和标准已牢固确立，并几乎被该领域专家一致接受。
questions.explanation: be well established 表示“已牢固确立/被广泛认可”，与 accepted 呼应；install 安装、organize 组织、contradict 反驳均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The new energy device mistakenly ___ the cost of electricity generation at around twice the likely figure.
questions.stemZh: 这种新能源设备错误地把发电成本估算为可能数字的两倍左右。
questions.explanation: estimate sth. at... 表示“把……估计为……”；consider 认为、recognize 认出、identify 识别，均不接 at 表数值。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: There is mounting ___ that people whose diets are rich in vitamins are less likely to develop some types of cancer.
questions.stemZh: 越来越多的证据表明，饮食中富含维生素的人患某些类型癌症的可能性较低。
questions.explanation: mounting evidence that... 表示“越来越多的证据表明”，evidence 为不可数名词；incident 事件、element 要素、example 例子均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: This article tells you how to ___ files from UNIX to other computer systems.
questions.stemZh: 本文介绍如何将文件从UNIX导出到其他计算机系统。
questions.explanation: 计算机领域把文件从一系统“导出”用 export；transport 运输、transmit 传输信号、convey 传达，都不如 export 专业。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Decisions are sometimes influenced by ___ such as the local authority's policies, political views of board members and the character of the appellant.
questions.stemZh: 决策有时受地方当局政策、董事会成员政治观点以及上诉人性格等因素影响。
questions.explanation: influenced by factors such as... 表示“受……等因素影响”；object 物体、point 观点、item 项目均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Many studies have been undertaken to investigate the ___ sustainability of traditional pension systems and reform options from the macroeconomic standpoint.
questions.stemZh: 已开展许多研究，从宏观经济角度考察传统养老金体系的财政可持续性及改革方案。
questions.explanation: 与 pension systems、macroeconomic 呼应，financial sustainability 指“财政可持续性”；cultural 文化的、ecological 生态的、sociological 社会学的均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: He developed a mathematical ___ describing the distances of the planets from the Sun.
questions.stemZh: 他提出了一个描述行星与太阳距离的数学公式。
questions.explanation: mathematical formula 指“数学公式”，用于描述行星距离；principle 原理、recipe 食谱/诀窍、regulation 规章均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: A school curriculum must fulfill its primary ___ of serving to open to new ideas the minds of those who follow it.
questions.stemZh: 学校课程必须发挥其主要功能，即让学习者的头脑乐于接受新思想。
questions.explanation: fulfill its function of... 表示“发挥……的功能”，为常用搭配；effect 效果、operation 操作、application 应用均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Contradiction between these two systems had been ___ as the driving force of change.
questions.stemZh: 这两种制度之间的矛盾一直被视为变革的驱动力。
questions.explanation: be identified as 表示“被认为是/被认定为”；be associated with 才表示“与……相关”，resume 恢复、guarantee 保证均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: From 1973 to 1994 per capita ___ declined and this economic deterioration played a major role in bringing political change.
questions.stemZh: 1973年至1994年间人均收入下降，这种经济恶化在带来政治变革方面起了重要作用。
questions.explanation: per capita income 是固定搭配“人均收入”；reward 报酬、profit 利润、wage 工资均不与 per capita 搭配表示总体收入。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: There had been two smaller surveys whose results ___ some degree of disturbance in the population.
questions.stemZh: 此前有两项规模较小的调查，其结果显示出一定程度的人口流动。
questions.explanation: results indicated... 表示“结果表明……”；appear/emerge 不及物“出现”，exhibit 展示物品，均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The services are attractively priced and tailored to suit ___ requirements.
questions.stemZh: 这些服务定价具有吸引力，并按个性化需求定制。
questions.explanation: tailored to suit individual requirements 指“按个性化需求定制”；separate 分开的、singular 单一的、isolated 孤立的均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The booklet is intended to provide a common ___ of these standards for use by the European chemical industry and certification bodies.
questions.stemZh: 这本小册子旨在为欧洲化学工业和认证机构提供对这些标准的统一解释。
questions.explanation: provide a common interpretation of... 表示“提供对……的统一解释”；translation 翻译、assumption 假设、composition 组成均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The cumbersome and time-consuming method of voting, which ___ each member walking between two tellers and announcing his name, is partly designed to stop members sending their footmen to vote for them.
questions.stemZh: 这种繁琐费时的投票方法要求每位成员走到两位计票人之间报出姓名，其部分目的是防止成员派仆人去代投。
questions.explanation: involve sb. doing sth. 表示“包含/需要某人做某事”；provide 提供、imply 暗示、revolve 旋转均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Since the key ___ is the psychological pressure that law can exert on every individual mind, the law must be clear, well diffused, and foreseeable.
questions.stemZh: 既然关键问题是法律能对每个人心理施加的压力，法律就必须清晰、广为传播且可预见。
questions.explanation: the key issue 指“关键问题”，与后文对法律的要求呼应；incident 事件、activity 活动、accident 事故均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Employers use immigrants as a source of cheap ___ and this also usefully weakens the workforce politically by creating internal divisions.
questions.stemZh: 雇主把移民当作廉价劳动力的来源，这也通过制造内部隔阂在政治上削弱了劳动力队伍。
questions.explanation: cheap labour 是固定表达“廉价劳动力”；power 权力、leisure 闲暇、function 功能均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: She won the court case, but she had to pay an enormous amount in ___ fees.
questions.stemZh: 她赢了官司，但不得不支付巨额律师费。
questions.explanation: legal fees 指“律师费/诉讼费”，与 court case 呼应；social 社会的、religious 宗教的、biological 生物的均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The Data Protection Act is a piece of ___ aimed at protecting the privacy of the individual.
questions.stemZh: 《数据保护法》是一项旨在保护个人隐私的立法。
questions.explanation: a piece of legislation 指“一项立法/法规”，与 Act 呼应；tension 紧张、investigation 调查、prescription 处方均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: This problem calls for a ___ change in the content of our primary education and for the raising of the school entry age.
questions.stemZh: 这一问题要求对小学教育内容作出重大变革，并提高入学年龄。
questions.explanation: a major change 指“重大变革”；heavy 沉重的、light 轻微的、tiny 微小的，均与“改革”语域不符。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: This problem calls for the application of a scientific ___ to understand the fundamental processes of biology.
questions.stemZh: 这一问题需要运用科学方法来理解生物学的基本过程。
questions.explanation: a scientific method 指“科学方法”，与 application 搭配；way/form/manner 虽可表方式，但 scientific method 是固定术语。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: If any of these symptoms ___ while you are taking the medication, consult your doctor immediately.
questions.stemZh: 服药期间如出现这些症状中的任何一种，请立即咨询医生。
questions.explanation: symptoms occur 表示“症状出现”；respond 反应、originate 起源、multiply 繁殖均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Over ninety ___ of the world's data is indeed not held in a relational database, and it may not be appropriate for all forms of information.
questions.stemZh: 世界上超过90%的数据确实并未存储在关系型数据库中，而且关系型数据库可能并不适合所有形式的信息。
questions.explanation: ninety percent of... 表示“百分之九十”，后接不可数名词 data 用单数 is；rate 比率、scale 规模、proportion 比例通常不直接跟数词加 of。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Unemployment in the first half of the year was 2.5 percent lower than in the same ___ of the year before.
questions.stemZh: 今年上半年失业率比去年同期低2.5个百分点。
questions.explanation: the same period of the year 指“去年同期”；phase 阶段（过程）、level 水平、session 会期均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: A loose fiscal ___ would give the economy a badly needed short-term boost but would fail to deal with a variety of deeper problems.
questions.stemZh: 宽松的财政政策会给经济带来急需的短期提振，但无法解决各种更深层的问题。
questions.explanation: fiscal policy 是固定搭配“财政政策”；case 案例、option 选择、issue 问题均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: In ___ , bonuses ought to fall when conditions get tough. In practice, they don't.
questions.stemZh: 原则上，情况艰难时奖金应当下降。但实际上并没有。
questions.explanation: in principle 表示“原则上”，与 in practice“实际上”形成对照；in reality 虽也表“事实上”，但与后文重复。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: This proposal is bound to stimulate the evolution of formal ___ for overcoming the obstacles met by investigators.
questions.stemZh: 这项提议必将促进正式程序的演变，以克服研究人员遇到的障碍。
questions.explanation: formal procedures for doing sth. 指“为做某事而设的正式程序”；process 过程、consequence 结果、service 服务均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: A bug in the computer system was preventing it from ___ digital image files.
questions.stemZh: 计算机系统中的一个缺陷使其无法处理数字图像文件。
questions.explanation: process files 指“处理文件”，为计算机领域常用搭配；proceed 前进、produce 生产、treat 对待/治疗均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Payments for emergency medical treatment, as ___ by the Road Traffic Acts, will not affect your no claim bonus.
questions.stemZh: 按《道路交通法》要求支付的急救医疗费用不会影响你的无索赔奖励。
questions.explanation: as required by... 表示“按照……的要求/规定”，多指法律法规；prescribe 开处方、demand 强烈要求、request 请求，都不如 required 正式。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Qualitative ___ is a process of naturalistic inquiry that seeks in-depth understanding of social phenomena within their natural setting.
questions.stemZh: 质性研究是一种自然主义探究过程，旨在深入理解自然情境中的社会现象。
questions.explanation: qualitative research 是固定术语“质性研究”；pursuit 追求、access 获取、measure 措施均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: In ___ to rapidly dwindling forest resources, there are in many nations afforestation programmes on both small and large scales.
questions.stemZh: 为应对迅速减少的森林资源，许多国家开展了大小规模的造林计划。
questions.explanation: in response to 是固定搭配“为回应……”；in answer to 也可，但 response 更常用于对策；reaction、feedback 不搭配 in ... to。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The kidney plays a vital ___ in the removal of waste products from the blood.
questions.stemZh: 肾脏在清除血液中的废物方面起着至关重要的作用。
questions.explanation: play a vital role in... 是固定搭配“在……中起重要作用”；task 任务、duty 职责、job 工作均不与 play a ... in 搭配。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: This questionnaire was divided into several ___ because it was necessary to collect information about the dementia sufferer from different sources.
questions.stemZh: 这份问卷被分成几个部分，因为需要从不同来源收集有关痴呆症患者的信息。
questions.explanation: 问卷被分为几个 section（部分）；object 物体、element 要素、region 地区均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: The finance for the project will come from both the government and the private ___.
questions.stemZh: 该项目的资金将来自政府和私营部门。
questions.explanation: the private sector 是固定表达“私营部门”；aspect 方面、zone 区域、sphere 领域均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Research in the field of genito-urinary medicine has led to ___ health advances in the last decade.
questions.stemZh: 泌尿生殖医学领域的研究在过去十年带来了重大的健康进步。
questions.explanation: significant advances 指“重大进展”；indifferent 漠不关心的、temporary 暂时的、commonplace 普通的均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Critics fear increased congestion problems ___ to those experienced by airlines because of air traffic control difficulties.
questions.stemZh: 批评者担心，由于空中交通管制困难，拥堵问题会加剧，类似航空公司所经历的情况。
questions.explanation: similar to 表示“与……相似”，作后置定语；common to 意为“共有的”，likely 可能、incline 倾向均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Experts are trying to track down the ___ of the contamination in the water supply.
questions.stemZh: 专家正试图追查供水污染的来源。
questions.explanation: track down the source of... 指“追查……的来源”，与污染搭配；origin 起源更抽象，result 结果、process 过程均不如 source 具体。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: A/An ___ provision in the agreement stated that research materials should not be used for commercial purposes.
questions.stemZh: 协议中有一项具体条款规定，研究材料不得用于商业目的。
questions.explanation: a specific provision 指“一项具体条款”，specific 与 provision 搭配最佳；definite 明确的、peculiar 奇怪的、especial 特别的都不如 specific 自然。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: They analysed the internal ___ of firms in the plastics, container and consumer food industries in terms of differentiation and integration.
questions.stemZh: 他们从分化和整合的角度分析了塑料、容器和消费食品行业公司的内部结构。
questions.explanation: internal structure of firms 指“公司的内部结构”；order 秩序、design 设计、layout 布局均不合。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: They are debating on the relationship between ___ and practice and the balance between conservation and innovation.
questions.stemZh: 他们正在讨论理论与实践的关系，以及保守与创新之间的平衡。
questions.explanation: theory and practice 是固定对应“理论与实践”；principle 原则、philosophy 哲学、generalization 概括均不与 practice 构成常用对照。

questions.label: 子表1
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表1
questions.stem: Among the ___ that could prevent us from finishing the building are the weather and the availability of materials.
questions.stemZh: 可能妨碍我们完成这栋建筑的可变因素包括天气和材料的可获得性。
questions.explanation: variables 指“可变因素”，与 weather、availability 并列作主语；variety 多样化、various 形容词、variation 变化均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: To ___ this purpose, the commission stresses the importance of having reliable and comparable information on health interventions.
questions.stemZh: 为了实现这一目的，委员会强调拥有可靠且可比的卫生干预信息的重要性。
questions.explanation: achieve the purpose 是固定搭配，表示“达到目的”；acquire/obtain 多指获得知识或物品，perform 常接 task/action。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The ___ of huge amounts of data has helped our research enormously.
questions.stemZh: 海量数据的获取极大地帮助了我们的研究。
questions.explanation: the acquisition of data 表示“数据的获取”；accomplishment/achievement 强调成就，registration 意为注册。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The editorial criticizes the college's ___ for not taking a stand on the issue.
questions.stemZh: 社论批评该学院管理层在这个问题上没有表明立场。
questions.explanation: college administration 指“学院管理层”，与后文“未表态”呼应；organization 机构、headquarters 总部、government 政府均不合语境。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: This assumption does not ___ the qualitative conclusions derived in the paper.
questions.stemZh: 这一假设并不影响论文中得出的定性结论。
questions.explanation: affect 及物，表示“影响结论”；react 不及物，常用 react to；attack 攻击、impress 留下印象均不搭配 conclusions。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: There has been research on teaching techniques for young learners, but what task types are ___ and efficient for testing children is an under-researched area.
questions.stemZh: 已有关于低龄学习者教学技巧的研究，但哪些任务类型适合且高效地测试儿童，仍是一个研究不足的领域。
questions.explanation: 与 and efficient 并列，需要褒义形容词，appropriate 表示“合适且高效”；relevant 相关的、contrary 相反的、complicated 复杂的均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: We must recognize that all ___ of human cultures are closely integrated.
questions.stemZh: 我们必须认识到，人类文化的各个方面都紧密相连。
questions.explanation: aspects of human cultures 指“人类文化的各个方面”；sides 侧重边或面，faces 指脸，points 指要点，均不如 aspects 准确。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The minister revealed that the banking industry needed ___ from the taxpayer to survive.
questions.stemZh: 部长透露，银行业需要纳税人的援助才能生存。
questions.explanation: need assistance from sb. to survive 表示“需要某人援助才能生存”；alienation 疏远、supervision 监督、resistance 抵制均与 survive 冲突。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Our responsibilities fall into two main ___: a coordination of branch recruitment work and our own independent initiatives.
questions.stemZh: 我们的职责分为两大类：协调分支机构招聘工作，以及我们自己的独立举措。
questions.explanation: fall into categories 是固定表达“分为……类”；views 观点、factors 因素、schools 学派均不能与 fall into 搭配表示分类。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: It was mentioned in the previous ___ of this book that an awareness of the marketing environment has become a key element in the "modern-day" approach to marketing.
questions.stemZh: 本书前一章提到，对营销环境的认识已成为“现代”营销方法的关键要素。
questions.explanation: 书的“章”用 chapter；division 指划分或部门，segment 指部分，episode 多指剧集或事件。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: A group of experts ___ by the finance ministry is thought to have recommended much self-regulation.
questions.stemZh: 据认为，财政部委托的一个专家组建议实行大量自我监管。
questions.explanation: experts commissioned by... 指“受……委托的专家”；represented 代表、contracted 签约、permitted 允许均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Drug trafficking is a matter of considerable concern for the entire international ___.
questions.stemZh: 毒品贩运是整个国际社会高度关注的问题。
questions.explanation: international community 是固定表达“国际社会”；company 公司、residence 住所、association 协会均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The whole ___ underground system is interlocked and related, and meticulously mapped.
questions.stemZh: 整个复杂的地下系统相互交错、彼此关联，并被精心绘制成图。
questions.explanation: complex system 指“复杂的系统”，与 interlocked and related 呼应；detailed 详细的、obvious 明显的、involved 多作表语。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The data can subsequently be loaded on a ___ for processing, which greatly improves work efficiency.
questions.stemZh: 随后数据可以加载到计算机上进行处理，这大大提高了工作效率。
questions.explanation: load data on a computer for processing 指“把数据载入计算机处理”；generator 发电机、manufacturer 制造商、parameter 参数均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Scientists are still unable to come to a/an ___ as to the probable cause of earthquake.
questions.stemZh: 科学家们仍无法就地震的可能成因得出结论。
questions.explanation: come to a conclusion 是固定搭配“得出结论”；elaboration 详述、prediction 预测、resolution 决心或决议均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: We are ___ a survey to find out what our customers think of their local bus service.
questions.stemZh: 我们正在开展一项调查，以了解顾客对当地公交服务的看法。
questions.explanation: conduct a survey 是正式搭配“开展调查”；attend 出席、regulate 管理、convey 传达均不能接 survey。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: This section of the report provides a ___ analysis of specific risks to wildlife that may be associated with the building of the dam.
questions.stemZh: 报告的这一部分对大坝建设可能给野生动物带来的具体风险进行了后果分析。
questions.explanation: consequence analysis 指“后果分析”，与对野生动物风险的分析吻合；structure/feasibility/quality analysis 分别指结构、可行性、质量分析，不合语境。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: He strongly proposed the ___ of databases on hazardous sites and especially events such as those involving toxic releases.
questions.stemZh: 他强烈建议建立关于危险场所特别是涉及有毒物质泄漏事件的数据库。
questions.explanation: the construction of databases 指“数据库的建设”；opposition 反对、destruction 破坏、instruction 指示均与 proposed 不搭。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Agricultural companies have failed to convince ___ that genetically modified foods are safe, so the market demand was shrinking.
questions.stemZh: 农业公司未能让消费者相信转基因食品是安全的，因此市场需求不断萎缩。
questions.explanation: 与 market demand 呼应，被说服的对象应是 consumers“消费者”；manufacturers 制造商、researchers 研究者、investors 投资者均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The whole team deserves ___ for bringing the project in on time.
questions.stemZh: 整个团队因按时完成项目而值得称赞。
questions.explanation: deserve credit for... 表示“因……值得称赞”；error/fault 错误、resent 怨恨（动词）均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The ___ life of the country will sink into atrophy unless more writers and artists emerge.
questions.stemZh: 除非涌现更多作家和艺术家，否则这个国家的文化生活将陷入萎缩。
questions.explanation: writers and artists 对应 cultural life“文化生活”；political 政治的、financial 财政的、religious 宗教的均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The building isn't ___ very well from the point of view of wheelchair access.
questions.stemZh: 从轮椅使用者的角度来看，这栋建筑的设计并不太好。
questions.explanation: be designed 指“被设计”，与 wheelchair access 搭配；invent 发明、discover 发现、adapt 改造或适应均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Martin Luther King clearly understood and accepted the ___ between preaching and scholarly criticism.
questions.stemZh: 马丁·路德·金清楚地理解并接受了布道与学术批评之间的区别。
questions.explanation: the distinction between A and B 表示“A 与 B 的区别”；variation 变化、transition 过渡、superiority 优越均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Disclosure of environmental information is an essential ___ in monitoring the progress towards achieving these objectives.
questions.stemZh: 环境信息公开是监测实现这些目标进展的关键要素。
questions.explanation: an essential element in... 指“做……的关键要素”；part 泛指部分，substance 物质，component 多指组成整体的部件。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Profit can be calculated using the simple ___ P=R−C (Profit = Revenue minus Cost).
questions.stemZh: 利润可以用简单的等式 P=R−C（利润=收入−成本）计算。
questions.explanation: P=R−C 是一个 equation“等式/公式”；relation 关系、association 关联、comparison 比较均不能指数学表达式。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Based on its ___ of market conditions, the company had decided not to repurchase shares at this time.
questions.stemZh: 基于对市场状况的评估，公司决定此时不回购股票。
questions.explanation: evaluation of market conditions 指“对市场状况的评估”；calculation 具体计算、generation 产生、demonstration 演示均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: With every software update comes new ___ to protect users, including parental controls and spam filtering.
questions.stemZh: 每次软件更新都会带来保护用户的新功能，包括家长控制和垃圾邮件过滤。
questions.explanation: software features 指“软件功能”；characters 字符或人物、trait 性格特征、specialties 特产或专长均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Construction will be postponed until the council approves the building's ___ design.
questions.stemZh: 施工将推迟到市议会批准该建筑的最终设计之后。
questions.explanation: final design 指“最终设计”，是开工前需审批的版本；initial 最初的、primary 主要的、eventual 最终结果的均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The media ___ on politicians' private lives inevitably switches the attention away from the real issues.
questions.stemZh: 媒体对政客私生活的关注不可避免地转移了人们对真正问题的注意力。
questions.explanation: focus on 是固定搭配“聚焦于”；aim 瞄准、point 指向、circle 环绕均不能与 on 搭配表达此义。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The increase in the number of young people leaving to work in the cities has had a dramatic ___ on the demography of the villages.
questions.stemZh: 离开农村去城市工作的年轻人数量增加，对村庄的人口结构产生了巨大影响。
questions.explanation: have an impact on 是固定搭配“对……产生影响”；result 结果、force 力量、contact 接触均不接 on 表影响。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: An employee who suffers personal ___ as a result of an act of violence may be eligible to receive an award from the Criminal Injuries Compensation Board.
questions.stemZh: 因暴力行为而遭受人身伤害的员工可能有资格获得刑事伤害赔偿委员会的赔偿。
questions.explanation: suffer injury 是正式表达“受伤”；ache/pain 指疼痛，wound 多指刀枪等造成的伤口，均不如 injury 贴合法律语境。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The state of Michigan has endowed three ___ to do research for industry.
questions.stemZh: 密歇根州资助了三家研究所为工业界开展研究。
questions.explanation: research institute 指“研究所”，与 do research 呼应；clinic 诊所、company/business 公司均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: There's been a significant ___ of time and energy in order to make the project a success.
questions.stemZh: 为使项目成功，投入了大量的时间和精力。
questions.explanation: investment of time and energy 指“时间和精力的投入”；experiment 实验、operation 操作、adventure 冒险均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The United States wants to eliminate tariffs on ___ such as electronics.
questions.stemZh: 美国希望取消电子产品等商品的关税。
questions.explanation: items such as electronics 指“电子产品等物品”；unit 单位、aspect 方面、issue 问题均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: A new online medical ___ devoted to neglected tropical diseases was founded last week.
questions.stemZh: 上周创办了一份新的在线医学期刊，专门关注被忽视的热带疾病。
questions.explanation: medical journal 指“医学期刊”；tabloid 通俗小报、diary 日记、manual 手册均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: A leak in the pipeline was discovered during routine ___ and inspection work.
questions.stemZh: 管道泄漏是在日常维护和检查工作中发现的。
questions.explanation: routine maintenance 是行业术语“日常维护”，与 inspection 并列；provision 提供、precaution 预防、perseverance 坚持均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The prison service should try to rehabilitate prisoners so that they can lead ___ lives when they leave prison.
questions.stemZh: 监狱管理部门应努力改造囚犯，使他们出狱后能过上正常生活。
questions.explanation: lead a normal life 指“过正常生活”，与 rehabilitate 呼应；habitual 习惯性的、ordinary 平凡的、typical 典型的均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: In the second experiment they ___ a very clear result.
questions.stemZh: 在第二个实验中，他们得到了非常明确的结果。
questions.explanation: obtain a result 是正式搭配“得到结果”；realize 意识到或实现、contain 包含、reward 奖励均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Staff ___ in professional conferences is encouraged by the management.
questions.stemZh: 管理层鼓励员工参加专业会议。
questions.explanation: encouraged by management 提示空白处应为正面行为，participation in“参与”最合；alienation 疏远、opposition 反对、discrimination 歧视均为负面。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Artificial intelligence is ___ to be a threat to employment.
questions.stemZh: 人工智能被视为对就业的威胁。
questions.explanation: be perceived to be 是正式表达“被认为”；estimate 多指估算数值，resume 恢复，receive 接收，均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Some Wall Street analysts described the management shakeup as a timely and ___ step toward restoring the company's credibility.
questions.stemZh: 一些华尔街分析师称此次管理层改组是恢复公司信誉的及时而积极的一步。
questions.explanation: 与 timely 并列，需要褒义词，positive step 指“积极的一步”；respective 各自的、objective 客观的、destructive 破坏性的均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: We estimate the ___ market for the new phones to be around one million people in this country alone.
questions.stemZh: 我们估计仅在这个国家，新手机的潜在市场就有约一百万人。
questions.explanation: potential market 是常见术语“潜在市场”；likely/probable 可能的、capable 有能力的均不与 market 搭配。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: It was mentioned in the ___ chapter that an awareness of the marketing environment has become a key element in the "modern-day" approach to marketing.
questions.stemZh: 前面一章提到，对营销环境的认识已成为“现代”营销方法的关键要素。
questions.explanation: the previous chapter 指“前一章”；earlier 多作状语，before 是介词或副词，front 指前面位置，均不如 previous 贴切。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The Red Cross's ___ concern is to preserve and protect human life.
questions.stemZh: 红十字会的首要关注是维护和保护人的生命。
questions.explanation: primary concern 是固定搭配“首要关注”；necessary 必要的、elemental 基本的、distinctive 独特的均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Except under clearly defined circumstances, it is illegal in Britain for a company to ___ its own shares.
questions.stemZh: 除非在明确界定的情况下，英国公司购买自己的股票是违法的。
questions.explanation: purchase shares 指“购买股票”；invest 投资常用 invest in，exchange 交换、communicate 沟通均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Several opponents have recently emerged, ___ from rival tech giants such as Microsoft and Amazon to small bodies representing authors and publishers across the world.
questions.stemZh: 最近出现了一些反对者，既有微软和亚马逊等竞争对手科技巨头，也有代表全球作家和出版商的小型机构。
questions.explanation: range from A to B 是固定搭配“从 A 到 B 不等”；extend 延伸、stretch 伸展、enlarge 扩大均不接 from...to... 表范围。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Coastal ___ of the country have much better infrastructure and many more Internet users than others.
questions.stemZh: 该国沿海地区的基础设施和互联网用户数量都远优于其他地区。
questions.explanation: coastal region 指“沿海地区”；land 指陆地，sector 多指行业部门，district 多指行政区。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Safety ___ are being ignored by company managers in the drive to increase profits.
questions.stemZh: 在追求利润的过程中，公司管理者忽视了安全规章。
questions.explanation: safety regulations 指“安全规章”；allocation 分配、obligation 义务、participation 参与均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The scientist corresponds with colleagues in order to learn about matters ___ to her own research.
questions.stemZh: 这位科学家与同事通信，以了解与她自己的研究相关的事项。
questions.explanation: relevant to 是固定搭配“与……相关”；consistent 后接 with，connected 后接 with，agreeable 后接 to 但意为“同意”。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: He entered the United States in 1988 as a permanent ___ because of his marriage to a U.S. citizen.
questions.stemZh: 由于与美国公民结婚，他于1988年以永久居民身份进入美国。
questions.explanation: permanent resident 是固定说法“永久居民”；citizen 公民、inhabitant 居住者、client 客户均不与 permanent 搭配。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The earth has limited ___, and if we do not recycle them we will use them up.
questions.stemZh: 地球的资源有限，如果我们不回收利用，就会把它们耗尽。
questions.explanation: limited resources 指“有限的资源”，与 recycle 和 use up 呼应；substance 物质、property 财产或属性、material 材料均不如 resources 全面。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Wellington Barracks is a ___ area and anyone who enters should have identification.
questions.stemZh: 惠灵顿兵营是一个限制区域，任何进入的人都应携带身份证明。
questions.explanation: restricted area 指“限制区域/禁区”，与查验证件呼应；limited 有限的、qualified 有资格的、defined 明确的均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The bank has taken additional ___ measures to ensure accounts are protected.
questions.stemZh: 银行采取了额外的安全措施以确保账户受到保护。
questions.explanation: security measures 是固定搭配“安全措施”；capability 能力、necessity 必要性、conformity 遵从均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The mathematics of physics should be explored, but new mathematical, statistical, and qualitative methodologies should also be ___.
questions.stemZh: 物理学的数学方法应予探索，但也应寻求新的数学、统计和定性方法。
questions.explanation: seek 的过去分词 sought，与 explore 呼应，表示“寻求新方法”；thought 思考、fought 斗争、brought 带来均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The bank has just been ___ as the preferred bidder for Brussels International Airport.
questions.stemZh: 该银行刚刚被选为布鲁塞尔国际机场的首选投标人。
questions.explanation: be selected as 指“被选为”，与 preferred bidder 呼应；relate 关联、adopt 采纳、realize 实现均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: They're planning to develop the whole ___ into a shopping complex.
questions.stemZh: 他们计划把整个场地开发成一个购物中心。
questions.explanation: develop the site into... 指“把该场地开发成……”；land 范围过大，scene 指现场，ground 指地面。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: Their marketing ___ for the product involves obtaining as much free publicity as possible.
questions.stemZh: 他们为该产品制定的营销策略包括尽可能获得更多免费宣传。
questions.explanation: marketing strategy 是常见术语“营销策略”；method 方法、technique 技巧、competence 能力均不如 strategy 贴合整体规划。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: We are conducting a/an ___ to find out what our customers think of their local bus service.
questions.stemZh: 我们正在进行一项调查，以了解顾客对当地公交服务的看法。
questions.explanation: conduct a survey 是固定搭配“开展调查”；license 许可证、expectation 期望、impression 印象均不能与 conduct 搭配。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The machine can recognize handwritten characters and turn them into printed ___.
questions.stemZh: 这台机器能识别手写字符并将其转换为印刷文本。
questions.explanation: printed text 指“印刷文本”，与 handwritten characters 对应；paper 纸张、essay 文章、chapter 章节均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: The biggest problem with ___ print textbooks is that they cost hundreds of dollars every semester.
questions.stemZh: 传统纸质教科书的最大问题是每学期要花费数百美元。
questions.explanation: traditional print textbooks 指“传统纸质教材”；historical 历史的、customary 习惯的、ancient 古代的均不合。

questions.label: 子表2
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表2
questions.stem: There will be a ___ of capital and technology from this country to Mongolia.
questions.stemZh: 将会有资金和技术从这个国家转移到蒙古。
questions.explanation: transfer of capital and technology 指“资金与技术转移”；transport 运输、transition 过渡、translation 翻译均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The State currently uses small electronic message boards to control traffic speeds and advise drivers of ___ routes around the Forth Road Bridge.
questions.stemZh: 该州目前使用小型电子留言板来控制车速，并告知司机绕行福斯公路桥的替代路线。
questions.explanation: alternative routes 指“备用/替代路线”；another 后接单数可数名词，不能与复数 routes 搭配，available“可用的”语义不符，alternate 作形容词多指“轮流的、间隔的”。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Cases are infrequent, tending to occur in ___ which evoke compassion rather than condemnation.
questions.stemZh: 这类案例并不常见，往往出现在令人同情而非谴责的境况中。
questions.explanation: in circumstances 是固定搭配，指“在某些情形下”；consequence 侧重“后果”，subsequence 指“后继”，circle 指“圈子”，均不能自然描述“引发同情”的处境。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Comments ___ John's mathematical development from other teachers made no reference to his strength in spatial skills.
questions.stemZh: 其他老师对约翰数学发展的评论没有提及他在空间技能方面的优势。
questions.explanation: comment on sth 是固定搭配，表示“对……发表评论”；此处 Comments on John's development 作主语中心。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Those operations across the Channel can pose quite complicated legal problems concerning matters of ___ for loss of life, injury and damage to property.
questions.stemZh: 英吉利海峡对岸的那些行动可能引发相当复杂的法律问题，涉及对人员伤亡和财产损失的赔偿事宜。
questions.explanation: compensation for loss of life 指“对生命损失的赔偿”；payment 只指付款行为，pressure/amendment 与赔偿语境无关。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The addition of extra hardware boards or ___ in the computer can, with suitable software, provide such thing as fast floating-point.
questions.stemZh: 在计算机中增加额外的硬件板卡或组件，配以合适的软件，就能提供快速浮点运算之类的能力。
questions.explanation: hardware components 指“硬件组件”，与 boards 并列；element 泛指要素，substance 指物质，particle 指微粒。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Testing patients without their ___ would constitute a professional and legal offence.
questions.stemZh: 未经患者同意就对其进行检测，会构成职业和法律上的违规行为。
questions.explanation: without one's consent 指“未经本人同意”；content 意为“内容”，presence 指“在场”，commitment 指“承诺”。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The body and mind are closely linked and can exert ___ influence over one another.
questions.stemZh: 身体与心灵紧密相连，能够对彼此产生相当大的影响。
questions.explanation: considerable influence 指“相当大的影响”；generate 是动词不能修饰名词，general 指“普遍的”，considerate 指“体贴的”。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: We consider a first order language with a wide range of ___, a set of variables, a set of predicate names and no function symbols.
questions.stemZh: 我们考虑一种一阶语言，它包含大量常量、一组变量、一组谓词名称，且不含函数符号。
questions.explanation: constants 与 variables（变量）相对，指逻辑语言中的“常量”；contrast 对比、maintenance 维护、content 内容均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: While the system has a gold standard in quality for apprenticeships, this can impose ___ that make/makes it harder to adapt to new digital industries.
questions.stemZh: 尽管该体系在学徒制质量方面具有黄金标准，但这可能施加种种限制，使其更难适应新的数字产业。
questions.explanation: impose constraints 是固定搭配，表示“施加限制”；impose 常与 constraint/restriction 搭配，control 较少作 impose 的宾语，hardship/problems 也不合该搭配。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The paper examines the ___ that gender roles and identities make to the overall configuration of resources available to particular individuals.
questions.stemZh: 本文考察性别角色与身份对特定个体可获得的资源总体配置所作出的贡献。
questions.explanation: make a contribution to 是固定搭配，表示“对……作出贡献”；distribution 分配、cooperation/collaboration 合作，均不能与 make ... to 构成此义。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Throughout the paper we adopt the following naming ___.
questions.stemZh: 在整篇论文中，我们采用以下命名约定。
questions.explanation: naming convention 是固定表达，指“命名约定/命名规范”；conclusion 结论、condition 条件、contradiction 矛盾均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Rather than being regarded as a ubiquitous characteristic of other approaches, this article focuses on ___ between relevant factors as the foundation of an improved approach.
questions.stemZh: 本文并不把它视为其他方法普遍具有的特征，而是聚焦相关因素之间的协调，将其作为改进方法的基础。
questions.explanation: coordination between factors 指“各相关因素之间的协调”；conduction 传导、corporation 公司、production 生产，均不合语境。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The ___ is a sample of rock which allows geologists to examine the strata in proper sequence and thickness.
questions.stemZh: 岩芯是一份岩石样本，使地质学家能够按顺序和厚度考察地层。
questions.explanation: core 在地质学中特指“岩芯”，正是供地质学家研究地层顺序与厚度的岩石样本；heart/center 只表“中心”，point 指“点”。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Analysis are expecting share prices to fall in the first quarter of next year because of poor ___ earnings.
questions.stemZh: 分析师预计，由于企业盈利不佳，明年第一季度股价将下跌。
questions.explanation: corporate earnings 指“企业盈利”，是商业领域的固定说法；income 泛指收入，selling 指销售，revenue 指营收，均不如 corporate earnings 贴合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: To clarify this analysis, income was up compared to that of the ___ period last year.
questions.stemZh: 为说明这一分析，收入与去年同期相比有所上升。
questions.explanation: corresponding period 是经济学术语，指“同期”；similar 相似、following 随后、previous 上一个，均不构成“同期”之意。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Researchers set out some simple ___ and began their enormous task.
questions.stemZh: 研究人员制定了一些简单的标准，随后开始了他们庞大的任务。
questions.explanation: set out criteria 表示“制定标准”；criteria 是 criterion 的复数，与 set out 搭配；guidance 不可数，steps/moves 与“制定”搭配不自然。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: New tax regulations would cut the ___ for business lunches.
questions.stemZh: 新的税收法规将削减商务午餐的税前扣除额度。
questions.explanation: tax deduction 指“税收扣除/减免”，与税务语境相符；induction 归纳、introduction 引入、production 生产均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Perhaps this is not surprising, given the differences in simulation methods and parameters used, but it ___ the importance of further work in this area.
questions.stemZh: 考虑到所用模拟方法和参数的差异，这或许并不令人意外，但它恰恰证明了在该领域开展进一步工作的重要性。
questions.explanation: demonstrate the importance 表示“证明……的重要性”；display/exhibit 指展示，certify 指正式证明/认证，语气与搭配不如 demonstrate 自然。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The field of molecular phylo-geography, which ___ the history of spatial isolation and geographic expansion of populations, has developed.
questions.stemZh: 分子系统地理学这一领域已发展起来，它记录种群空间隔离和地理扩张的历史。
questions.explanation: document the history 表示“记录历史”，符合学科研究语境；report 侧重报道，sketch 指概述，keep 不与 history 这样搭配。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Gram-positive bacteria were marked as ___ species in most cases, and biodiversity was rather high.
questions.stemZh: 在多数情况下，革兰氏阳性菌被标为优势种，且生物多样性相当高。
questions.explanation: dominant species 是生态学固定说法，指“优势种”；advantageous 指有利的，prominent 指出众的，excellent 指优秀的，均非专业术语。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: One of the prevailing themes of mid-century modern architecture is a nearly equal ___ on function and form.
questions.stemZh: 20 世纪中期现代建筑的主流主题之一，是对功能与形式的近乎同等的强调。
questions.explanation: emphasis on 是固定搭配，指“对……的强调”；contribution/dedication/attention 的介词均非 on，且语义不如 emphasis 贴切。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Random assignment would ___ that all unmeasured confounding factors were equally distributed between comparison groups.
questions.stemZh: 随机分配能够确保所有未测量的混杂因素在各比较组之间均匀分布。
questions.explanation: ensure that... 表示“确保……”；prove 需接事实而非 that 从句的保障义，admit 承认、indicate 表明，均不如 ensure 贴合随机分配的作用。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Messages that are considered less relevant for a query are put lower in the list or are ___ from the display.
questions.stemZh: 与查询相关性较低的信息会被排在列表更靠后的位置，或被从显示中排除。
questions.explanation: exclude from 表示“从……中排除”；include 与句意相反，involve 指涉及，revolve 指旋转。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Our best chance of preventing such devastating acts of terror is to act within the ___ of international law.
questions.stemZh: 我们防止此类毁灭性恐怖行为的最佳机会，是在国际法框架内采取行动。
questions.explanation: within the framework of 是固定搭配，指“在……框架内”；outline 纲要、base 基础、foundation 地基/基础，均不接 within the ... of 表此义。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The regeneration program is ___ by EU money which has been collected from those member nations.
questions.stemZh: 这项重建计划由从那些成员国征集的欧盟资金资助。
questions.explanation: be funded by 表示“由……资助”；found 意为“创立”，given/provided 与 by EU money 搭配不表资助。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The next example also ___ another feature of this model which is distinctively different from the other models.
questions.stemZh: 下一个例子还说明了该模型的另一特征，这一特征与其他模型明显不同。
questions.explanation: illustrate a feature 表示“说明某一特征”；draw 画画、write 写、appoint 任命，均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: According to the order of "persons subject to ___ control", these foreign students would have no access to local authority assistance.
questions.stemZh: 按照“受入境管制人员”的规定顺序，这些外国学生将无法获得地方当局的援助。
questions.explanation: immigration control 指“入境/移民管制”，与“受……管制的外国人”语境相符；military 军事、finance 财政、education 教育均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The fact that the theoretical debate has moved to a meta level ___ that archaeology is developing into an intellectual discipline.
questions.stemZh: 理论争论已上升到元层面这一事实，意味着考古学正在发展为一门知识学科。
questions.explanation: imply that... 表示“暗示/意味着……”；say/tell 主语多为人，convey 侧重传达信息，imply 更贴合由事实推出的深层含义。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Economists had expected GDP growth to be revised upwards from last month's ___ estimate of 0.6%.
questions.stemZh: 经济学家此前预计，GDP 增长将从上月 0.6% 的初步估计值向上修正。
questions.explanation: initial estimate 指“初步估计”；beginning 指开端，intimate 指亲密的，preparatory 指预备的，均不与 estimate 构成此义。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: There were several ___ of computer failure before the system worked properly.
questions.stemZh: 在系统正常运行之前，曾出现过数次计算机故障。
questions.explanation: instances of 表示“……的实例/事例”；condition 条件、stance 立场、sample 样本，均不如 instances 贴合“故障事例”。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: His research aims at understanding consciousness as a natural biological phenomenon and at fruitful ___ between philosophical and empirical research in the study of consciousness.
questions.stemZh: 他的研究旨在把意识理解为一种自然的生物现象，并致力于在意识研究中实现哲学研究与实证研究之间富有成果的互动。
questions.explanation: interaction between A and B 指“A 与 B 之间的互动/相互作用”；comparison 比较、communication 交流、conclusion 结论，均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: It also provides an additional ___ of why targeted research on the distributional benefits of agricultural research is important.
questions.stemZh: 它还提供了又一个理由，说明为何针对农业研究分配效益开展定向研究十分重要。
questions.explanation: justification of why... 指“说明……为何合理的理由”；study/survey 研究调查不能直接作“理由”，calculation 计算不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The case examples show that commonality potential can be realized ___ different layers of the product architecture within a product family.
questions.stemZh: 案例表明，在一个产品家族内部，通用性潜力可以在产品架构的不同层面上实现。
questions.explanation: on different layers 指“在不同层面上”，layer 常与介词 on 搭配；in/at/to 与 layers 搭配均不自然。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The inextricable ___ between health and people's human/natural environments create a basis for an ecological approach to health.
questions.stemZh: 健康与人类/自然环境之间不可分割的联系，为采取生态学的健康研究路径奠定了基础。
questions.explanation: links between A and B 指“A 与 B 之间的联系”；response 回应、contact 接触、joint 关节/接头，均不如 links 贴切。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The third type of operation involves feeding receivers' false ___ data, say, reporting the position of a person's cell phone a dozen or so miles from its actual position.
questions.stemZh: 第三类操作涉及向接收方提供虚假的位置数据，例如报告某人手机的位置距其实际位置约有十几英里。
questions.explanation: location data 指“位置数据”，与后文 reporting the position 呼应；profession 职业、status 身份、education 教育均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The ___ load for this elevator is eight persons for the sake of safety and cost-efficiency.
questions.stemZh: 出于安全和成本效益的考虑，这部电梯的最大载重为八人。
questions.explanation: maximum load 指“最大载重”；由“八人”这一上限可知应选 maximum，minimum 意为最小，increased/decreased 指增减。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: ___ refers to a group of people who share some characteristic by birth that makes their group smaller than some other groups in a society and may cause others to treat them unfairly.
questions.stemZh: 少数群体指这样一群人：他们因某种与生俱来的特征而人数少于社会中的其他群体，并可能因此受到他人不公平对待。
questions.explanation: minority 指“少数群体”，与定义中“人数较少、可能受不公平对待”相符；majority 指多数，minimum/maximum 指最小/最大值。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: A/An ___ charge or current has the same electrical charge as an electron.
questions.stemZh: 负电荷或负电流所带的电荷与电子相同。
questions.explanation: negative charge 指“负电荷”，与电子的电荷性质一致；passive 被动、active 主动、affirmative 肯定，均非电学术语。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: All these possibilities should be weighed against the likely ___ in order to confirm the most applicable scheme.
questions.stemZh: 应当把所有这些可能性与可能的结果相权衡，以确定最适用的方案。
questions.explanation: likely outcome 指“可能的结果”，与 weigh ... against（权衡）搭配自然；ending 结尾、goal 目标、finding 发现，均不如 outcome 贴切。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: A ___ is a company that is owned by two or more people, who share in the risks and rewards of the business.
questions.stemZh: 合伙企业是由两个或更多人共同拥有的公司，他们共担经营风险、共享经营收益。
questions.explanation: partnership 指“合伙企业/合伙关系”，正合“由两人或以上共同拥有、共担风险共享收益”的定义；relationship 关系、merger 合并、league 联盟均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: ___ refers to theory or logical analysis of the principles underlying conduct, thought, knowledge, and the nature of the universe.
questions.stemZh: 哲学指的是对行为、思想、知识以及宇宙本质背后原理所作的理论或逻辑分析。
questions.explanation: philosophy 指“哲学”，与“行为、思想、知识及宇宙本质之原理的理论或逻辑分析”相符；physiology 生理学、psychology 心理学、biology 生物学均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The program led by a group of scientists at home and abroad is designed to address both ___ and emotional health.
questions.stemZh: 由国内外一批科学家主导的这一项目，旨在同时解决身体健康与情绪健康问题。
questions.explanation: physical and emotional health 指“身体健康与情绪健康”，是常见搭配；body 是名词不能修饰 health，mental/psychological 与 emotional 语义重复。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: As shown in the graph above, the size of the window seems out of ___ to the height of the wall.
questions.stemZh: 如上图所示，窗户的尺寸似乎与墙的高度不成比例。
questions.explanation: out of proportion to 是固定搭配，指“与……不成比例/不相称”；width 宽度、place 地方、position 位置，均不构成此搭配。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Last week the government ___ statistics suggesting that pupils attending the colleges performed less well than expected at the previous report.
questions.stemZh: 上周，政府公布了统计数据，显示就读这些学院的学生表现不如上一次报告所预期的那么好。
questions.explanation: publish statistics 指“公布统计数据”；render 使成为/提供，deny 否认，remove 移除，均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: After century-long scientific study, scientists realize that ozone is produced by the ___ between oxygen and ultra-violet light.
questions.stemZh: 经过长达一个世纪的科学研究，科学家们认识到臭氧是由氧气与紫外线之间的反应产生的。
questions.explanation: reaction between A and B 指“A 与 B 之间的反应”，此处指臭氧的生成反应；connection 连接、response 回应、action 行动均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Many students ___ for these courses to widen skills for use in their current jobs.
questions.stemZh: 许多学生报名参加这些课程，以拓宽可用于当前工作的技能。
questions.explanation: register for courses 是固定表达，指“课程注册/报名”；resign 辞职、assign 分配、involve 涉及，均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Manufacturers said that an increased reliance ___ imports of liquefied natural gas would result in more volatile (波动的) prices.
questions.stemZh: 制造商表示，对进口液化天然气依赖的加剧将导致价格更加波动。
questions.explanation: reliance on 是固定搭配，表示“对……的依赖”；其余介词均不与 reliance 构成此义。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: This treatment ___ the most stubborn stains by soaking in a mild solution of bleach.
questions.stemZh: 这种处理方法通过浸泡在温和的漂白剂溶液中来去除最顽固的污渍。
questions.explanation: remove stains 指“去除污渍”；reduce 减少、move 移动、prevent 阻止，均不如 removes 贴切。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Measures to speed up the planning process for ___ between schools and industry will be welcomed by both parties.
questions.stemZh: 加快校企合作方案规划进程的措施将受到双方的欢迎。
questions.explanation: scheme 指“方案、计划”，与 planning process for ... 搭配；procedure 程序、schedule 时间表、connection 联系，均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The technique offers a means of ___ the human genome much more quickly.
questions.stemZh: 这项技术提供了一种更快速地对人类基因组测序的方法。
questions.explanation: sequence the human genome 是生物学术语，指“对人类基因组测序”；order 排序、describe 描述、depict 描绘，均非专业说法。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: ___ is defined as either of the two major forms of individuals that occur in many species and that are distinguished respectively as female or male especially on the basis of their reproductive organs and structures.
questions.stemZh: 性别被定义为许多物种中个体存在的两种主要形态之一，主要依据其生殖器官和结构分别区分为雌性或雄性。
questions.explanation: sex 指“性别”，与定义中按生殖器官区分为雌雄相符；human 人类、sight 视觉、sense 感觉，均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: In Physics, a ___ is a change in the observed frequency of a wave, as of light or sound.
questions.stemZh: 在物理学中，频移指观测到的波（如光波或声波）频率的变化。
questions.explanation: shift 在物理学中指“频移”，即观测到的波频变化；move/movement 指移动，transfer 指转移，均非术语。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: As is known to all the students, the regulations ___ that calculators may not be used in the examination.
questions.stemZh: 所有学生都知道，规章明确规定考试中不得使用计算器。
questions.explanation: specify that... 指“明确规定……”；suggest 暗示、request 请求、remind 提醒，均不如 specify 符合规章的正式语气。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: An original paper should not include an extensive review of the literature, but only ___ references to indicate the purpose and relevance of the investigation.
questions.stemZh: 原创论文不应包含大量文献综述，而只需列出足够的参考文献，以说明研究的目的和相关性。
questions.explanation: sufficient references 指“足够的参考文献”；efficient 高效的、deficient 不足的、abundant 大量的，均与“只需足量”之意不符。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Fragmentation, the experience of work subdivided into a series of unconnected ___ not requiring the worker's full attention, is also a common experience.
questions.stemZh: 碎片化——工作被拆分成一系列互不相关、无需工人全神贯注的任务——也是一种常见的体验。
questions.explanation: task 指“任务”，与“工作被拆分成若干互不相关的任务”相符；part/bit 只指部分，step 指步骤，与 a series of 搭配不如 tasks。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Beyond the time used to discuss ___ issues like arrangements of the project, these meetings included time for members to build personal relationships and contacts.
questions.stemZh: 除了用于讨论项目安排等技术性问题的时间之外，这些会议还留出时间让成员建立个人关系和联系。
questions.explanation: technical issues 指“技术性问题”，与项目安排等事务性内容相对；rhetorical 修辞的、skillful 熟练的、resourceful 足智多谋的，均不合。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: On the other hand, organic production ___, particularly crop rotation, can reduce risk in the longer term.
questions.stemZh: 另一方面，有机生产技术，尤其是轮作，能够从长期上降低风险。
questions.explanation: technique 指具体的“技术、方法”，crop rotation（轮作）即一种农业技术；approach 侧重途径，skill 指技能，method 较泛。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: Dairy producers are experimenting with new ___ to reduce the cholesterol in milk.
questions.stemZh: 奶制品生产商正在试验新技术，以降低牛奶中的胆固醇。
questions.explanation: experiment with new technologies 指“试验新技术”；rule 规则、field 领域、skill 技能，均不与 experiment with 搭配表此义。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: There is no requirement for the content provider to check the ___ of the credit card number.
questions.stemZh: 并不要求内容提供方核实信用卡卡号的有效性。
questions.explanation: validity 指“（信用卡等的）有效性”；effectiveness 侧重效果，effect 指影响，function 指功能，均不如 validity 准确。

questions.label: 子表3
questions.chapter: 学术英语词表 子表3
questions.stem: The titles of the second and the third ___ do not mention concepts such as "decline", "crisis" or "climaterium".
questions.stemZh: 第二卷和第三卷的标题都没有提到“衰退”“危机”或“更年期”之类的概念。
questions.explanation: volume 指书籍的“卷、册”，可受序数词 the second/third 修饰并用复数；number 指号码，quantity 数量，quality 质量，均不合。
